title: API Versioning Strategies
summary: API versioning enables backward-compatible changes using URL paths, headers, or query parameters.

content.overview: Versioning allows evolving APIs without breaking existing clients.
content.details: Strategies: URL versioning (/v1/users, /v2/users); Header versioning (Accept: application/vnd.api.v1+json); Query parameter (/users?version=1).
content.examples: V1: GET /v1/users; V2: GET /v2/users with different response format.
content.caveats: URL versioning is recommended for simplicity and discoverability, but may complicate HATEOAS if not managed.
